title: Chromatin Immunoprecipitation Protocol for Rice Seedlings
author: Telma Fernandes
materials: Divide the samples into two tubes and add 50 µl Anti-FLAG‱M2 magnetic beads (Sigma, USA) to the chromatin solution and incubate at 4 °C overnight with rotation.
Combine the two supernatants into a single tube.

steps.title: Harvest and Prepare Rice Leaves
steps.instruction: Harvest 3 g of young rice leaves (approximately 70 plants, 14 days old), cut into 1–2 cm pieces, and place loosely in a vacuum flask with a stirrer.

steps.title: Fix Tissues via Vacuum Infiltration
steps.instruction: Submerge leaves in 200 ml of 1% p-formaldehyde solution and vacuum infiltrate at room temperature for 15 min (vacuum up to 50 mbar, short release, and repeat cycle). Stir for an additional 1 min without vacuum.

steps.title: Stop Cross-linking
steps.instruction: Add Glycine 2 M (13 ml of 2M Glycine in 200 ml of 1% formaldehyde solution) to the flask and mix vigorously. Vacuum infiltrate again for 5 min, releasing vacuum every 30 seconds.

steps.title: Rinse and Dry Tissue
steps.instruction: Rinse the tissue two or three times with water to remove all formaldehyde, then blot between paper towels to remove excess water.

steps.title: Grind and Initial Extraction
steps.instruction: Grind 3 g of cross-linked tissue in liquid nitrogen into a fine powder, transfer to 50 ml tubes, and resuspend in extraction buffer 1 (0.4 M sucrose, 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8, 10 mM MgCl2, 5 mM β-mercaptoethanol, 0.1 mM PMSF, and 1x protease inhibitor cocktail tablet).

substeps.instruction: Do not add the entire buffer at once.
Tap the tube on the bench to remove N2 from the mix.

steps.title: Filter and Incubate Solution
steps.instruction: Filter the solution through four layers of Miracloth in a funnel into a fresh 50 ml Falcon tube on ice. Repeat once if necessary to remove debris. Incubate for 10 min on ice, vortexing occasionally.

steps.title: First Centrifugation and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtered solution for 20 min at 3000× g at 4°C. Gently remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 ml of extraction buffer 2 (0.25 M sucrose, 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8, 10 mM MgCl2, 1% Triton X-100, 5 mM β-mercaptoethanol, 0.1 mM PMSF, 1x protease inhibitor cocktail tablet).

steps.title: Second Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Transfer the solution to a 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube and centrifuge at 12,000× g for 10 min at 4°C.

steps.title: Sucrose Cushion Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Gently remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 300 μl of extraction buffer 3 (1.7 M sucrose, 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8, 2 mM MgCl2, 0.15% Triton X-100, 5 mM β-mercaptoethanol, 0.1 mM PMSF, 1x protease inhibitor cocktail tablet). Layer this on top of 1 ml of the same extraction buffer and centrifuge for 1 h at 12,000 × g at 4°C.

steps.title: Chromatin Resuspension
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant and resuspend the chromatin pellet in 300 μl Nuclei Lysis Buffer (50 mM Tris-HCl pH 8, 10 mM EDTA, 1% SDS, 1x protease inhibitor cocktail tablet).

substeps.instruction: Keep a 5 µl aliquot on ice and add 5 µl of H2O for agarose gel analysis as an 'unsheared' chromatin control.

steps.title: Sonicate Chromatin
steps.instruction: Sonicate the chromatin solution. Perform a time course sonication experiment to determine the optimal number of cycles for desired DNA fragment sizes.

substeps.instruction: For the time course: start with 300 µl sample, select cycles to test, and collect a 10 µl aliquot of sheared DNA after each cycle for agarose gel analysis.

steps.title: Clear Supernatant Recovery
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 10 minutes at 4°C to pellet cell debris. Transfer the clear supernatant (approximately 300 µl) to a new 1.5 ml vial.

steps.title: Prepare Input DNA Control
steps.instruction: Remove 50 μl of the supernatant to a clean tube and store at –20 °C as the ‘input DNA control’.

steps.title: Analyze Sonication Efficiency
steps.instruction: Perform the following analysis on the 5 µl unsheared sample (+ 5 µl water) and 10 µl sheared DNA sample:

substeps.instruction: Reverse Crosslinking: Add 0.67 µl NaCl 4 M and incubate overnight at 65°C.

RNAse and Proteinase K treatment: Add 2.5 µl EDTA 0.5 M, 5 µl Tris-HCl pH 6.5 1 M, 2 µl RNAse (20 mg/ml), and 82 µl H2O. Incubate 30 min at 42°C. Add 0.5 µl Proteinase K (20 mg/ml) and incubate 90 min at 42°C.
Phenol-chloroform isoamyl pH 8: Add 100 µl H2O and 200 µl Phenol-chloroform-isoamyl alcohol (25/24/1) pH 8. Spin 10 min at full speed and keep the supernatant.

DNA precipitation: Add 20 µl NaAc pH 5.2 3 M, 2 µl glycogen, and 500 µl EtOH 96%. Incubate at –80°C for 15 min. Spin 20 min at full speed. Remove supernatant and wash with 500 µl EtOH 70%. Spin 10 min at full speed. Remove supernatant, dry the pellet, and resuspend in 7 µl H2O.
Estimate efficiency and concentration via 1% TAE agarose gel electrophoresis.

steps.title: Dilute Sample
steps.instruction: Dilute the sample 10x with ChIP dilution buffer (1.1 mM Tris-HCl pH 8, 1.2 mM EDTA, 167 mM NaCl, and 1.1% Triton X-100).

steps.title: Wash Beads
steps.instruction: Perform the following sequential washes on the recovered beads, each for 5 min at 4 °C:

substeps.instruction: Wash twice with Low Salt Buffer (150 mM NaCl, 0.1% SDS, 1% Triton X-100, 2 mM EDTA, 20 mM Tris-HCl pH 8).
Wash twice with High Salt Buffer (200 mM NaCl, 0.1 %SDS, 1% Triton X-100, 2 mM EDTA, 20 mM Tris-HCl pH 8).
Wash twice with LiCl wash buffer (50 mM LiCl, 1% NP-40, 1% sodium deoxycholate, 1 mM EDTA, 10 mM Tris pH 8).
Wash twice with TE buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8, 1 mM EDTA).

steps.title: Elute DNA Complexes
steps.instruction: Carefully remove as much TE buffer as possible from the beads. Add 250 μL elution buffer (1% SDS, 10 mM EDTA, 0.1 M NaHCO3), vortex briefly, and incubate at 65°C for 15 min with gentle agitation.

steps.title: Reverse Cross-linking
steps.instruction: Reverse cross-linking for samples (including input control samples + 500 µl elution buffer) by adding 20 μL of 5 M NaCl and incubating at 65°C for 6 hours.

steps.title: Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Add 10 µl of 0.5 M EDTA, 20 µl 1 M Tris-HCl (pH 6.5), and 2 µl of 10 mg/ml proteinase K to the samples and incubate at 45°C.

steps.title: Final DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract DNA using phenol-chloroform-isoamyl alcohol (25/24/1) pH 8. Recover by precipitation with ethanol in the presence of 0.3 M NaAc (pH 5.2) and 2 μl glycogen carrier (10 mg/ml). Wash DNA pellets with 70% ethanol and resuspend each pellet in 20 μl of sterile distilled water.
